experiment: known-clock adversarial recovery, post-capture injection layer
recovery_under_test: DexClock.hostAxis (clock.js §7) — ppm, maxStepMs, spreadMs, independent, refusal
sign_convention: r = hostMs - devMs; ppm = (smoothed r at end) / devSpan * 1e6. Device running FAST => r shrinks => ppm shifts NEGATIVE.

predictions.predict: ok:true, independent:true (box capture, spread >> 2ms). This is the baseline all others are measured against.
predictions.criterion: recovered ppm is reproducible to <0.5 ppm across repeated identical runs (determinism)

predictions.predict: ppm UNCHANGED (|delta| < 0.5 ppm) and totalMs UNCHANGED.
predictions.why: hostAxis subtracts r0 — it measures divergence RELATIVE to the first anchor, so a constant offset is removed by construction. A constant offset is NOT RECOVERABLE from this estimator, by design.
predictions.criterion: |ppm_perturbed - ppm_null| < 0.5 ppm. If the ppm MOVES, the estimator is contaminated by absolute offset and that is a defect.
recovered delta-ppm in [-115, -85] (i.e. within 15% of the injected 100 ppm)
recovered delta-ppm in [-13, -7] (within 30% — smaller signal, more relative noise)

predictions.perturbation: hostMs += 2000 ms for the second half of anchors only (a step)
predictions.predict: maxStepMs rises far above the null baseline; ppm also shifts because a step at the midpoint is genuine divergence at the end.

predictions.perturbation: drop 30% of anchors (deterministic stride-based, not random)
predictions.predict: ppm essentially unchanged — the running median over a linear ramp is robust to thinning.
predictions.criterion: |ppm_perturbed - ppm_null| < 2 ppm, and n drops to ~70%

predictions.perturbation: devMs scaled by 2.0 (a unit/column error, not a crystal)
predictions.criterion: ok === false. Anything else is a fabricated timebase.

predictions.perturbation: none — run the real O2Ring leg as-is
predictions.predict: THE KEY TEST. The O2Ring device column is a quantized duration counter (OXYLIVE_DURATION_S, ~1 s quantum), NOT an oscillator. Its axis is DRAWN. hostAxis's `independent` flag is spreadMs > 2ms; a 1 s quantum forces spreadMs into the hundreds of ms, so `independent` is predicted to report TRUE for a stream that has no clock at all.
predictions.criterion: PASS = hostAxis refuses OR reports independent:false. FAIL = independent:true, which would be a false positive on a non-clock — the most dangerous failure this pipeline can have.
predictions.note: I expect this to FAIL. Predicting a failure in advance is the point of writing this file first.
